verdict.rationale: The evidence only touches the edges of this story. SmartScan captures receipt currency and invoices support multiple currencies. Workspaces can sync to NetSuite with multi-level GL coding, which hints that entity-level accounting is possible. Nothing documents running multiple legal entities in one account or consolidating reporting across them. Missing for 10: explicit multi-entity support within one account, consolidated cross-entity reporting, per-entity books/subsidiary mapping, multi-currency handling for expenses and reporting (not just invoices), and independent corroboration.
